title: Bug bash: adjuster workbench
story: As the sponsor I want the adjuster demo to read as a finished product: human labels, consistent AI confidence, a useful activity feed
acceptance: Every defect assigned to area 'adjuster' is fixed with a regression test, or explained
Audit clean on adjuster and supervisor screens for both tenants
Full npm test: no new failures
brief: Defect list comes from the audit phase.

verdicts.reason: Independent run on port 18703 (screenshots /tmp/qe-adj-18703/audit and /tmp/qe-adj-18703/pw). Most of the fix holds: supervisors land on All claims and adjusters on My claims; the Policy panel is filled in; AI suggestions now show provider, model and confidence; the false 'could not reach its confidence threshold' text is gone (it now names carrier policy); KPT-000001/AUR-000001 show the police report; I saw no failed API calls on any adjuster or supervisor claim for either tenant; adjuster tests pass 76/76. BLOCKER, criterion 2 (audit clean, no raw codes): on Aurelia, the 'Why this triage' panel shows raw coverage codes to both the adjuster and the supervisor. AUR-2026-000007 and AUR-2026-000014 read 'Handling complexity is medium because coverage outcome is not_covered', and AUR-2026-000004 reads '...coverage outcome is needs_review'. The text comes from src/modules/triage/complexity.mjs:18 (reason string) through triage/explain.mjs. The adjuster view shows it as-is, and nothing was posted to the hub about it, which contradicts the report's claim of 'no raw codes'. Fix: humanise the coverage-outcome phrase in the adjuster render or service (or request the change from the triage owner and show a mapped label in the meantime), and add a regression test with a not_covered/needs_review claim. Minor: the IC's note says Kestrel Fast-tracked reads 0, but the supervisor inbox shows 3 (KPT-000002/7/12 are fast-tracked again in the current seed); please make sure no test hard-codes that count. Full npm test: 1635 pass, 10 fail (3 of them TODO). None of the failures are in adjuster files: route roles for agent (claims/coverage), tenants.test queues, mock-pas PII hashes, /config/public, admin/CSR/claimant UI. They come from other teams' changes that are still in progress. The adjuster-landing 404 in the audit is /favicon.ico (curl confirms 404), which is outside this ticket.
